task.instruction: Check the leaderboard for Golf's DP World Tour in the SPORT section, what was the name of the most recent tournament, and how many teams have a Total of -10 strokes.

final_answer:
On the BBC Sport DP World Tour leaderboard, the most recent tournament is the **Abu Dhabi Championship** (live, 5–8 November 2026, played at Yas Links, par 72, 7,425 yards, $9,000,000 prize money).

At a Total of 10 under par (-10 strokes) there are **7 entries**, all tied for 19th place: Richard Sterne (South Africa), Francesco Molinari (Italy), Wenyi Ding (China), Frederic Lacroix (France), Kristoffer Reitan (Norway), Julien Guerrier (France) and Martin Couvra (France). Each has a three-round strokes figure of 206.

For context, the top of the leaderboard is Jon Rahm at 18 under par, followed by Rory McIlroy and Tyrrell Hatton at 17 under par.

judge.rationale: The final page shows DP World Tour “Abu Dhabi Championship” and seven players at -10; the answer states the tournament and count correctly.
